ALLIES_ARCHITECT_EVENT.title: The Mysterious Architect
ALLIES_ARCHITECT_EVENT.intro: Architect: ...Interesting. A warrior from another dimension, and one clad in blue at that. Your arrival... was expected, yet also unexpected.
ALLIES_ARCHITECT_EVENT.taunt: Architect: Hmph, the so-called Commander Tanya. You think your outdated weapons and tactics can help you survive in this Spire? Your world is but a speck of dust among countless parallel universes.
ALLIES_ARCHITECT_EVENT.response: Tanya: Outdated?! You think hiding in this tower playing with fancy mechanisms makes you impressive? I've fought in more wars than you've seen blueprints! The Soviet Iron Curtain, Yuri's psychic control, threats from other dimensions... I've conquered them all! This Spire? It's just another battlefield to conquer!
ALLIES_ARCHITECT_EVENT.conclusion: Architect: ...Ha! It's been a long time since I've met someone with such fighting spirit. Your determination... is worthy of respect. Perhaps... we can come to some arrangement. When we meet again, I hope you can prove your worth.
ALLIES_ARCHITECT_EVENT.finish: You leave the Architect's dimension, your heart filled with renewed fighting spirit.
